name: gizza-ai/magnet-link-parser
summary: Parse and build BitTorrent magnet links

tool.description: Parse a BitTorrent magnet: link into its structured parts (info-hash, display name, trackers, web seeds, sources, keywords, length), or build a magnet: link from parts. parse mode reads magnet; build mode reads info_hash plus optional fields.

mode.description: Direction: 'parse' (default) decodes a magnet: link; 'build' assembles one from parts.

magnet.description: Parse mode: the magnet: URI to decode. A bare query string is also accepted.

info_hash.description: Build mode: the v1 info-hash — 40 hex chars, 32 base32 chars, or a urn:btih:<hash>. Required to build.

display_name.description: Build mode: the display name (dn). Optional.

trackers.description: Build mode: tracker URLs (tr), newline- or comma-separated. Optional.

web_seeds.description: Build mode: web-seed URLs (ws), newline- or comma-separated. Optional.

exact_length.description: Build mode: exact total length in bytes (xl). Optional.
